description: This Java source file defines an Android activity called SensorTest that demonstrates the use of device sensors, specifically the accelerometer. It includes sensor event handling, visual rendering via a custom View, and gesture detection based on sensor data.

classes.name: SensorTest
classes.description: Main activity class that manages sensor setup, event handling, and rendering the sensor data visually.

classes.name: SensorTest.RunAve
classes.description: Helper class for computing a weighted moving average of sensor samples.

classes.name: SensorTest.SampleView
classes.description: Custom View for rendering sensor data as a graphical shape and handling drawing logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes sensors and view upon activity creation.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers sensor listener when activity resumes.

methods.name: onStop
